name: CompressRows8x2
adaptation: Filter a row-major 8x2 byte matrix along axis zero. Keep row i iff mask bit i is one, preserving original row order. Pack the selected two-byte rows consecutively in the low 128 output bits and zero every unused byte. Bits [131:128] contain the count of selected rows, 0..8. A zero mask returns an entirely zero output record, not a missing transaction. This is the complete stable Compress operator with a fixed-capacity, count-bearing representation of its variable-length result.
